assets.name: Zuck.exe
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: final standalone square portrait for Cancel City card game. Create a NEW illustration of the fictional satirical alter ego Zuck.exe, recognizably inspired by Mark Zuckerberg; the attached reference image is STYLE GUIDANCE ONLY, not an edit target. Match its grotesque punk underground comic art: thick energetic black ink outlines, dense scratchy crosshatching, textured cheap paper, distressed vivid screen-printed colours, exaggerated confrontational face, detailed hand-drawn anatomy. Square full-bleed chest-up or tight waist-up composition, head dominates frame, instantly legible at thumbnail size. No card frame, border, UI, titles, readable lettering, logos or watermark. Rich detailed background with symbolic props. High resolution at least 1024 square. Subject: A recognizably Mark Zuckerberg-inspired satirical cartoon, slim pale man with short curly brown hair, very wide unblinking eyes and stiff empty smile. Wearing an oversized dark hoodie over an android torso, one palm holds a glowing blue miniature cage made of app-window shapes, the other hand gives an unnaturally rigid thumbs-up. Cyan and purple surveillance screens with abstract eye symbols, no brands or letters. Preserve the exaggerated fictional robot persona and bold grimy illustrated art, not photorealism.
inspection_notes: Square full-bleed, face dominates; grotesque scratchy black ink and distressed cyan-purple print palette match style reference.
Recognizable Zuckerberg-inspired fictional robot persona with short curly hair, wide unblinking eyes, fixed grin, dark hoodie and exposed android torso.
Glowing blue app-window cage held on palm and rigid thumbs-up are clear; surveillance screens show abstract eyes.
No readable lettering, title, card border, logo or watermark visible.
